paretoAnalysis.interpretation: Pareto-relevant policies under the evaluated setup: POLICY_CCV_2_OF_4, POLICY_CCV_1_OF_4. POLICY_CCV_3_OF_4 is mathematically PARETO-DOMINATED by POLICY_CCV_2_OF_4, which achieves both lower application payload and lower test MAE under this setup. Under a balanced decision criterion prioritizing communication efficiency with minimal accuracy loss, POLICY_CCV_2_OF_4 represents the best observed trade-off among selective policies on the Pareto frontier.
